Docs / Releases

Release 4.2

This release closes the gap between what the scheduler reports and what it does. Upgrading is safe from 4.0 and 4.1; from 3.x, read the 4.0 notes first.

Fixed

  • A queued run no longer loses its place when a second one is requested.
  • Webhook deliveries are de-duplicated on their id, not on their timestamp.
  • Retry storms after a failed sync. Still open — tracked as #4117.

Limits that moved

SettingWasNow
Queue depth64256
Delivery timeout5 s30 s
Retained runs50500

Upgrading

Stop the workers, apply the migration, then start them again:

systemctl stop acme-worker
acme migrate --to 4.2
systemctl start acme-worker

Questions go to support@example.com.
